Though you prevail against Wicked Thunder, the levinsteed-empowered fighter who can bend electrope to her will, she manages to escape in a sudden flash of lightning. An anxious Yaana surely awaits you in the greenroom.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion attendant in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_SEQ_03: Yaana is genuinely impressed that you managed to claim victory over her sister, but appears troubled that she disappeared yet again. As it will be some time before matches in the next tier begin, she suggests you both return to Tritails Training.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_SEQ_04: The witch for a new age reveals a shocking truth: the extended use of feral souls causes an affliction called psychonekrosis, a fatal ailment which eats away at one's soul. Eutrope herself suffers from the illness, and seemingly wishes for Yaana to leave the Arcadion so she does not succumb to the same fate. The only cure, according to Eutrope, is the exceedingly dense soul of a person─such as yours. Metem suddenly arrives however, prompting the Arcadion fugitive to flee. The stylish commentator urges you to become the grand champion, that you may release all the souls in the repository without arousing the president's suspicion.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_SEQ_05: Yaana is thankful she has you by her side as she goes through this difficult time. She's of a mind to continue acting as your second, while otherwise working with Neyuni to investigate an alternative cure for Eutrope. Though cruiserweight matches have yet to begin, a cartoonist named Gabbro is quite interested to hear a direct account of your battles in the Arcadion, and Yaana believes it would be worth your while to speak with him.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_SEQ_00: This Hoobigo messenger is looking for a well-traveled adventurer.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_SEQ_01: There is trouble in Mamook, and Miilal Ja is hopeful the unique insights of an adventurer may shed new light on the situation. Assuming you are willing, the Hoobigo messenger bids you go and speak with her at once.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_SEQ_02: As Miilal Ja explains it, their troubles began when they found an armor-clad stranger unconscious in the Skydeep Cenote. They have no means of deducing whence he came, and he himself can remember nothing of who he is. Before they can press further, however, Zereel Ja barges in with upsetting news─the shade of Gulool Ja Ja has returned to Yak T'el. Bakool Ja Ja labors to keep the apparition at bay, but his chances appear grim. The Landsguard will soon be assembled to assist him, but Miilal Ja fears their help will be too little, too late. To that end, she asks you venture to Gok Draak Descent to help her son.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_SEQ_03: You find Bakool Ja Ja down, but not yet out, somehow managing to hold his own. Before you can take up arms, another enemy─a young girl named Prishe─soon joins the fray. She is eager to fight, but the shade suggests a tactical withdrawal, disappearing into a nearby portal. Bakool Ja Ja is unsatisfied with this conclusion, and so he gives chase, heedless of what dangers may be lurking beyond the rift.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_SEQ_04:
The stranger's brief altercation with Prishe has helped him to recall part of his past. He now remembers enough to know that Prishe is a friend, and that some malevolent force has likely taken hold of her. While determined to go and rescue her, his body is quick to protest his attempts to leave. You insist that he rest, regarding the portal with equal parts determination and trepidation.

※Jeuno: The First Walk can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_SEQ_05: No sooner do you step through the portal than you arrive in what appears to be a city, littered with monsters. The ensuing battle feels like a fever dream, unseen powers whisking you from one locale to the next. After overcoming what appears to be the last of the nightmarish foes, you somehow find yourself back where you started in the mysterious city.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_SEQ_06: Bakool Ja Ja arrives carrying a slumbering Prishe. She soon stirs awake, bereft of any memory of your previous encounters. Mysteries abound as you struggle to make sense of your surroundings.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_SEQ_07: You and Bakool Ja Ja emerge from your ordeal with more questions than answers, but for now you are safe. He thanks you for your timely assistance, but it remains to be seen if he will have further need of your strength.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SEQ_00: Prishe is almost definitely probably certain you are standing in Jeuno.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SEQ_01:
Prishe appears to have returned to her normal self, but she has no memory of your prior altercation, nor can she remember who first brought her to Jeuno. For want of clues as to how and why you are arrived there, Prishe suggests speaking with the scant few denizens wandering about the city.

※In the event that you leave Lower Jeuno, you may re-enter via the portal in Gok Draak Descent.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SEQ_02:
With Prishe in tow, you set off in search of answers. She is hopeful at least one locale, a place called the Tenshodo, will prove an eventful destination.

※You must be accompanied by Prishe to complete this task. Speak with her again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SEQ_03: Together you and Prishe speak with a number of residents, but much like the two of you, they all appear bewildered by the present state of affairs in Jeuno. Without other potential leads, you elect to return to Bakool Ja Ja.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SEQ_04:
You return to Bakool Ja Ja with greater certainty that you are in Jeuno, but little else. The armor-clad wanderer arrives soon after by way of the portal, but is dismayed to hear that Prishe has no idea who he is. Even now he struggles to recall his own name, and so Bakool Ja Ja offers him one─Alxaal. The group begins to talk in circles, and an exasperated Bakool Ja Ja cries out in frustration. Much to everyone's surprise, his cries are soon answered by none other than Sareel Ja.

He claims to be the architect behind the city and its denizens, using the power of echoes from a place beyond space and time. His goal is to create a new ruler for Tural, and perhaps even the world, by combining the strength of powerful entities from another world─Vana'diel. Sareel Ja's confidence in his plan is palpable as he vanishes into the aether, leaving behind a promise to return once further preparations are complete.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SEQ_05: You at last have answers, but not at all what you had hoped for. Prishe in particular appears stricken by Sareel Ja's revelations. The only pressing question now is when will Sareel Ja return, and will you be ready for him?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_SEQ_00: Alxaal regards Prishe with a pained look in his eyes.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_SEQ_01: The group is still shaken by Sareel Ja's revelations, but there is no time to be disheartened, nor to linger. Bakool Ja Ja suggests returning to Mamook to regroup and consider your next course of action.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_SEQ_02: Until Sareel Ja elects to reveal himself, there is naught to do but wait and prepare. Eyeing an opportunity for Prishe and Alxaal to learn more of your world, Bakool Ja Ja suggests they tend to their preparations in Tuliyollal. They will need to travel by dirigible, and so he asks that you go ahead and await them at the city's landing site.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_SEQ_03: No sooner do the three arrive than Bakool Ja Ja remembers he must first go and apprise the Landsguard of all that has happened. Thinking of how you might occupy the intervening time, food immediately springs to mind─more specifically, Aunt Tii's tacos. He offers you coin to cover the meal, then promptly takes his leave.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_SEQ_04:
Together with Prishe and Alxaal, you set off for Aunt Tii's Tacos, the myriad sights along the way evoking memories of Vana'diel. It will not be long before you arrive at your destination, much to the delight of a famished Prishe.

※You must be accompanied by Prishe and Alxaal to complete this task. Speak with either of them again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_SEQ_05: You gorge yourselves on tacos, with time enough left over for Prishe to tell you of her home, Tavnazia, and for you to share a few stories of your own. Bakool Ja Ja arrives soon after, his thoughts fixed squarely on Jeuno and the threat it poses. Rumor has it that misguided adventurers are actively seeking out the city's portal, believing it to contain untold treasure. He intends to keep them out, and Prishe and Alxaal are eager to assist.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_SEQ_06: Prishe appears wholly satisfied with her meal and grateful for your company. But all good things must come to an end, for now you must set your sights on Jeuno.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SEQ_00: Bakool Ja Ja is ready to return to Jeuno.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SEQ_01: Prishe and Alxaal's tour of Tuliyollal is cut short by a pressing need to return to Jeuno. Keen to do his part, Alxaal urges the group onwards, and thus do they depart for Yak T'el.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SEQ_02: Alxaal struggles to believe anyone would willingly venture into the unknown of Jeuno, but Bakool Ja Ja knows all too well the lengths people will go to in the pursuit of treasure. He is resolved to see any would-be treasure seekers vacated as they enter the city.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SEQ_03: You find two explorers wandering about Jeuno. While one is willing to leave with little resistance, the other is adamant about staying, claiming someone was yelling in the streets about treasure. What could this treasure be, and how will you convince whoever found it to leave their ill-gained spoils behind?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SEQ_04: You happen upon a thief that has managed to procure a block of electrope. He refuses to relinquish the stone, and Bakool Ja Ja rightly surmises that only coin will persuade him. Before an offer can be made, however, the conversation is interrupted by two explorers with an interest in buying the stone for themselves. Hoping to resolve this pecuniary problem as swiftly as possible, Alxaal proposes an auction, selling the electrope to the highest bidder.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SEQ_05: Despite the explorers' struggle, their monetary might is no match for your financial finesse. The auction is over and the electrope is yours.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SEQ_06: As Alxaal approaches the electrope, he senses a malevolent presence he immediately recognizes as the Shadow Lord. It calls to mind memories of his journey with a band of adventurers who he alleges brought low the real Shadow Lord in Vana'diel. Another step toward recovering his identity, but there will be more time for reminiscing once the electrope is taken to a safe location. With that in mind, you all return to Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SEQ_07: Prishe and Alxaal now find themselves idle until Sareel Ja returns. To pass the time, Bakool Ja Ja suggests they go on a journey, exploring the lands of Tural. The two are keen to answer the call of adventure, hopeful the experience will steel them for the battles to come.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_SEQ_00: The affable researcher is trying to get your attention.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_SEQ_01: An affable researcher introduces himself as Professor Claudien's new assistant, and requests your presence at Aporia on behalf of his superior. It seems Pandæmonium has intrigue to offer yet, and Claudien would make you a part of it.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_SEQ_02: Professor Claudien and his colleagues greet you warmly before explaining that, inspired by a memory Claudien glimpsed of Erichthonios's past, they have commissioned a commemorative mammet of Themis for the young warder. As you are the only one who can return to the past, it falls upon you to travel to Pandæmonium and deliver it to your erstwhile companion.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_SEQ_03: Upon arriving in Pandæmonium, you encounter Hegemone. While she understands the allure of witnessing his reaction to your gift, she cautions that as Erichthonios is currently training hard to become a more masterful warder, he may prefer to delay any reunions until he has made greater progress. As an alternative to a face-to-face encounter, she proposes that you conceal yourself in the shadows as she speaks with him, and send out the mammet when the time is right.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_SEQ_04: From your hidden vantage, you learn that despite some hardship, the young warder is doing well under his father's tutelage. At Hegemone's cue, you send the mammet out from hiding, which prompts a pleasantly surprised Erichthonios to remark that he but recently met the emissary at the Words of Lahabrea─where they spoke fondly of their dear friend . Before he can look too closely at the smile in the shadows nearby, Hegemone sends him away on his next task, happily accompanied by the Themis-shaped keepsake of your time together.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_SEQ_05: Pleased to have been able to assist in your delivery via the art of subterfuge, Hegemone wishes you well as you depart Pandæmonium for what may be the last time. Now all that remains is to return to Claudien and report your success.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_SEQ_06: As a reward for your efforts, Claudien presents you with a Themis mammet of your very own. Now you, too, carry a reminder of friendships forged across the endless expanse of time.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_SEQ_00: Yaana's face lights up at the sight of you.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_SEQ_01: In the midst of your hiatus from the Arcadion, you find Yaana in front of her gym, and are pleasantly surprised to discover that she has been hoping to see you. She remarks that though cruiserweight matches have yet to begin, she and Neyuni have made a breakthrough in their research about psychonekrosis. It seems they would share it with you inside.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_SEQ_02: Neyuni reveals that after a failed attempt to access Everkeep's core systems, she was furnished with data from Origenics courtesy of Oblivion, and has discovered a means to evaluate the condition of one's soul. Equipped with such knowledge, Yaana would examine her comrades in the light-heavyweight division to determine if they have been afflicted with psychonekrosis. Having received your blessing to do so, she wastes no time in contacting Honey B. Lovely, her senior at the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_SEQ_03: Honey is shocked by your revelation, and is all too happy to retire from the Arcadion, declaring she will pursue a new avenue for her talents. Relieved that Honey was more understanding than anticipated, Yaana states there is one more whom she would inform and examine: the Brute Bomber. Together, you set off for the place of his dwelling, residential radius 9-11.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_SEQ_04: Upon entering his apartment, the peculiar sight of the Brute Bomber surrounded by a trio of adorable kittens meets your eyes. Beside him stands the Howling Blade, his childhood friend, who informs you that the pair owe the president of the Arcadion a debt of gratitude they can never repay. Carefully reading the air, he takes his leave, allowing Yaana to reveal the dire cost of using feral souls to the Brute Bomber. You are already too late, however, as Neyuni's examination indicates his soul already shows signs of the affliction. The diagnosis is proven true not a moment later when the Brute Bomber suffers from a severe bout of dizziness, a symptom of the disease. Yet in spite of the mounting evidence and Yaana's earnest warnings, he remains in denial. The three of you depart his room with faint hope he will have a change of heart.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_SEQ_05: With yet another person stricken by the disease, Yaana and Neyuni are resolved to find a cure as soon as possible. You are interrupted in the midst of your deliberations by a call from Metem, who relays that cruiserweight matches are soon to begin. Having been summoned to meet him in the greenroom of the Arcadion, Neyuni vows to continue researching a cure while you and Yaana focus on winning your upcoming matches.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_SEQ_06:
The Arcadion attendant welcomes you cordially, and graciously guides you through the facility's familiar halls to the greenroom.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion attendant in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_SEQ_07: No sooner do you enter the room than a boisterous playboy pops open a bottle of champagne, ostensibly in celebration of your arrival. Taken aback, you turn looking for Metem, and instead spot a conspicuous lass vandalizing the room with graffiti. The colorful pair greet you before suddenly departing, and Metem informs you that they shall be your opponents in the cruiserweight tier.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_SEQ_08: The time has come to begin your cruiserweight campaign. Yaana implores you to psych yourself up for the coming matches, as each of your rivals wield more potent souls─and greater power─than your foes in the light-heavyweight tier.
TEXT_KINGRA202_05290_SEQ_01:
Yaana quickly introduces your first opponent: Dancing Green. Reportedly a shameless playboy, his passion for partying has manifested in his ring itself, where his rivals are forced to dance to his rhythm. Yet Yaana has every confidence that you have the moves to emerge on top, and so it is that you set your mind to the task of facing the dancing king.

※AAC Cruiserweight M1 can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGRA202_05290_SEQ_02:
The king has been uncrowned after a glorious match on the dance floor, where your moves were met with raucous applause. Yaana will be eager to congratulate you on your victory.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion attendant in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA202_05290_SEQ_03: Yaana is ecstatic about your achievement, and has renewed confidence that you possess the strength to face the increasingly empowered foes of the cruiserweight tier. After such an unusual foe, however, you can only wonder what surprises await in your next match...
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_SEQ_00: Yaana is ready to introduce your next opponent.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_SEQ_01:
Your next foe is to be Sugar Riot, a notorious graffiti artist-turned-Arcadion fighter. According to Yaana, the rambunctious rebel considers the ring her gallery, and you can expect the manifestations of her imagination to come forth within in boundless ways...

※AAC Cruiserweight M2 can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_SEQ_02:
Though Sugar Riot is every bit the artist you were expecting, when it comes to the arts of war, she proves no match for you. Yaana undoubtedly wishes to celebrate this latest triumph.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion attendant in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_SEQ_03: Seizing the moment following your victories, Yaana informs Dancing Green and Sugar Riot about psychonekrosis. The pair are naturally taken aback, but after giving her words careful consideration, announce their intention to retire from the Arcadion. Yaana believes that an alternative outlet for their talents may have been key, as with Honey B. Lovely. For the Brute Bomber and the Howling Blade, however, the Arcadion is all they have, and Yaana appears to be at a loss as to how she can persuade them otherwise...
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_SEQ_00: Yaana appears to be lost in thought.
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_SEQ_01: While Yaana remains gravely concerned for her fellow fighters, for now she turns her attention to preparations for the upcoming title match. To that end, she asks you to accompany her back to Tritails Training.
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_SEQ_02: Upon entering the gym, you see a broadcast of the Brute Bomber issuing you a challenge. Metem soon rushes into the room, explaining that the president has granted the vile heat a grudge match with you on the condition that he employs multiple feral souls. Such an act could potentially be lethal, yet the president's word is absolute to the former champion, and so you have no recourse but to face the reckless heel. Once you have seen to your preparations, a chauffeur awaits at the Arcadion to deliver you to the battlefield.
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_SEQ_03:
After informing you that Ascension Arcadia has made various preparations for the battle of its own, the chauffeur delivers you to your destination.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion chauffeur in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_SEQ_04:
You arrive at the venue to find the Brute Bomber waiting. Yaana pleads for him to abandon his plan to inject himself with multiple feral souls, unfortunately to no avail. The chimerical creature which forms before your eyes bears no resemblance to the man who formerly stood before you, and Metem quickly observes this fact by declaring the man-turned-monster the Brute Abombinator. His life hangs in the balance, and if you are to keep your promise to Yaana, you shall need to fight harder than ever before in this vengeful showdown.

※AAC Cruiserweight M3 can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_SEQ_05:
In the battle to stop your transfigured foe, you have not only survived being flung across buildings, but being smashed into them as well. Now, you have only to await Yaana and Metem's arrival.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion chauffeur in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_SEQ_06: By the time Yaana reaches you, it is clear that psychonekrosis has already claimed the Brute Bomber's life. With the president still furious that his secret has been revealed, Metem departs in hopes of pacifying his anger. No sooner does he leave than the Howling Blade arrives. Mourning the untimely passing of his dearest friend, he reveals that he too suffers from the affliction, and intends to continue down his path as an Arcadion fighter─even if the sole destination is death.
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_SEQ_07: Frustrated that she was unable to convince the Brute Bomber and the Howling Blade not to throw their lives away, Yaana's exasperation reaches a boiling point. When she has regained some calm, she notices that Neyuni is nowhere to be seen, and you, too, are left to wonder where the young girl might have gone...
TEXT_KINGRA205_05293_SEQ_00: Worry is writ plain on Yaana's face.
TEXT_KINGRA205_05293_SEQ_01: Worried for the missing Neyuni, Yaana searches for her by tracking down her terminal's signal, and discovers that she has left Everkeep. After recent events, you cannot help but feel concerned for the young girl yourself, and so you agree to help Yaana search for any signs of her precocious sister in the vicinity of East Yyasulani, her terminal's coordinates.
TEXT_KINGRA205_05293_SEQ_02: Breathing a sigh of relief, you find Neyuni safe and sound in East Yyasulani. The happy reunion is cut short, however, when Eutrope appears, revealing that summoning Neyuni had been a ploy to face you in the wild. After a brief clash between siblings, Yaana defeats her enfeebled sister, who is at last willing to speak candidly. Eutrope reveals that all the heavyweight fighters have already manifested psychonekrosis, yet continue to fight on, just like Retsarra─the Howling Blade. It was for his plight, and her heavyweight comrades, that she sought a cure. To her horror, however, it is at that moment that even Yaana experiences a bout of psychonekrosis-induced dizziness. An exasperated Neyuni takes this opportunity to mention her discovery of a potential cure to the disease─a stimulant which enhances an individual's “regeneration factor.” Now seeing the folly of her actions, Eutrope expresses her remorse to you before suddenly fainting.
TEXT_KINGRA205_05293_SEQ_03: Resolved to save Retsarra from himself, Yaana has a plan she would enact: by utilizing Honey B. Lovely's star power, she conspires to have the unstoppable upstart and the Howling Blade agree to a wager with all of Alexandria watching. The stakes are high indeed─the loser of the upcoming match would be forced to retire. An audacious scheme, but whether the cruiserweight champion would agree to such a gamble remains to be seen. According to Yaana, you shall rendezvous with the sweet-but-deadly songstress at Mosaic, the lone wolf's haunt, to execute the plan.
TEXT_KINGRA205_05293_SEQ_04:
With a helping hand from the crowd─some of whom, as it turns out, were planted there by the redoubtable starlet to coax the champion─Yaana's scheme has borne fruit. Now, all that remains is to seize victory in the coming match.

※In the event that you leave the greenroom, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion attendant in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA205_05293_SEQ_05: Offering some encouraging words, Yaana implores you to give the cruiserweight champion what for in the title match. With the Brute Bomber's tragic death still fresh in your memory, and countless others' hopes resting on your shoulders, you know this is a battle you must win.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_SEQ_00: Yaana would formally introduce the cruiserweight champion.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_SEQ_01:
Yaana explains that the Howling Blade was formerly a hunter before becoming a fighter. Employing the soul of the legendary wolf Fenrir in the ring, he complements his unparalleled swordsmanship with extraordinary speed. To save the lone wolf's life, you must best him in battle─and that shall be no trifling task.

※AAC Cruiserweight M4 can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_SEQ_02:
After evading a veritable squall of swift slashes and magicks both tempestuous and seismic, you have cornered the wolf and seized victory. Yaana will doubtlessly be overjoyed by your accomplishment.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion attendant in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_SEQ_03: A dejected Howling Blade joins you and Yaana in the greenroom, and asks how he is to go on without his career as a fighter. Frustrated, Yaana explains to him how blind he has been, ignoring the suffering of his dearest friend, and that of his beloved. Her words strike a chord in his heart, helping him to finally accept the truth he refused to acknowledge─that the president must be stopped. Retiring his ring name, Retsarra now intends to join you at Tritails Training to chart your next course of action.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_SEQ_04: Upon returning to the gym, you discover that Neyuni and Eutrope are nowhere to be seen. On cue, the voice of the president emanates from the monitor, revealing why: due to your acts of spreading information regarding psychonekrosis and convincing other fighters to retire, the megalomaniac executive has seen fit to abduct Yaana's sisters. Should you veer from his so-called script again, the pair may come to harm, and thus your only path forward is clear: you must become grand champion of the Ascension Arcadia Championship. Before he ends the transmission, the president mentions the stimulant Neyuni discovered in her research, officially known as the Drop of Life. Ascend to the top, and he promises to divulge its location.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_SEQ_05: A crestfallen Yaana broods in silence outside Tritails Training. Finally, she speaks, reiterating her faith in you, with hope that you will return to compete in the heavyweight matches and see to whatever preparations necessary before they begin. For not only her sisters' sakes, but that of countless others, the unstoppable upstart must press on, and keep fighting the good fight.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SEQ_00: The Landsguard's furrowed brow suggests all is not well in Yak T'el.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SEQ_01: There has been another sighting of what the Landsguard believe to be echoes in Yak T'el. Realizing the threat they pose to Tural, Bakool Ja Ja has already set off to confront them, and your assistance has been requested. The last sighting was reported by Toraal Ja in Mamook. Perhaps they can tell where in Yak T'el you can find Bakool Ja Ja.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SEQ_02: Toraal Ja informs you that Bakool Ja Ja was hunting for the echoes somewhere to the north of Gok Draak Descent when last they spoke, and he was ordered to escort you there. He asks that you climb aboard his mount when you are ready to set off.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SEQ_03: You find Bakool Ja Ja, and he has already slain the echoes which soon dissipate into motes of electrope. Amidst their remains, however, you find a letter penned by Sareel Ja. His preparations for your next trial are complete, and he invites you to return to Jeuno. Not wishing to risk further attacks from potentially greater echoes, you accept his invitation and make for Jeuno.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SEQ_04:
After a brief wait, Sareel Ja makes his dramatic entrance, the Shade of Gulool Ja Ja by his side. He boasts of his visions of grandeur, confident his plans will succeed with the help of a newly created echo─Kam'lanaut, the Archduke of the Grand Duchy of Jeuno. Prishe steps forward to exchange words, but he has grown tired of her meddling, and attempts to strike her down. Surprisingly, Bakool Ja Ja pushes her out of harm's way, though he is injured in the process. Prishe elects to stay behind and tend to his wounds, leaving you and Alxaal to brave the dangers ahead.

※San d'Oria: The Second Walk can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SEQ_05: You step through a portal and find yourself in yet another unfamiliar city, danger lurking around every corner. Battle leads you across several strange locales, culminating in a harrowing confrontation with Kam'lanaut and his brother Eald'narche. You emerge victorious, but Alxaal is nowhere to be found.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SEQ_06: Sareel Ja congratulates you on your victory, though you can see little cause for celebration. Prishe believes his bravado in the wake of defeat is all bluster, but he assures her that his plans proceed apace. Indeed, the wheels in his mind already appear to be turning toward a new selection of echoes. He takes his leave once more, leaving you to wonder what schemes he might unfurl when next he appears.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SEQ_07: Despite the events of the day, Alxaal's resolve to stop Sareel Ja remains unshaken. Prishe's, perhaps, less so. Unfortunately, there is naught to be done save bide your time and prepare for the next inevitable confrontation.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_SEQ_00: Bakool Ja Ja is putting his heads together to consider your next move.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_SEQ_01: Sareel Ja is once again beyond your reach, leaving you and your companions little recourse save to return home and prepare for your next encounter. Vexed though he is by your present predicament, Bakool Ja Ja understands the futility of his idle rantings. And so, he suggests that you all reconvene at Brightploom Post.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_SEQ_02: Before Sareel Ja elected to show himself, Prishe and Alxaal were taking in the sights of Tural, hopeful of discovering some hint as to the nature of electrope. An admirable mission, but one that Bakool Ja Ja explains is ultimately futile without venturing to the source of electrope─Alexandria. To help further their investigation, Bakool Ja Ja contacts Oblivion, who express a keen interest in meeting Alxaal and Prishe. In fact, they suggest a meeting on the outskirts of Alexandria. To that end, the four of you prepare to set off, first making a stop at Sheshenewezi Springs.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_SEQ_03: No sooner do you arrive at Sheshenewezi Springs than you're approached by a distressed Eldite man looking for his daughter. Prishe claims to have seen a girl matching her description somewhere to the south. With time remaining before your meeting with Oblivion, you agree to help look for her. Together with Alxaal and Prishe, you make for a nearby settlement to the south, hopeful the residents there have seen the wayward young girl.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_SEQ_04: Though most have seen neither hide nor hair of Jasper's daughter, one worker spotted her just outside the settlement not long ago. Perhaps Alxaal has good news to share.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_SEQ_05: Alxaal has also heard tell of a girl seemingly lost, wandering about south of the settlement. He wastes no time rushing off in search of her.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_SEQ_06: In catching up with Alxaal, you also happen upon Prishe. While contending with local scalekin, she says she spied what may have been Scoria nearby. Your search appears to be drawing to an end.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SEQ_00: Prishe is ready to keep moving.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SEQ_01: You find Scoria safe and sound. When asked about why she ran off, Scoria explains that her father intends for them to move to Tuliyollal, and the thought of leaving Alexandria upset her. She wants to be a singer, but worries the people of Tural will not like her music. Having seen firsthand the myriad peoples of Tural, Prishe tries to help her see the bigger picture, telling her that being different is what will make her music special. Scoria is heartened by her words, even feeling so bold as to share her music with the three of you. Now that she is safe, her heart put at ease, all that remains is to return to Sheshenewezi Springs and reunite her with her father.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SEQ_02: Jasper is at a loss as to how he might repay you for your timely assistance. Scoria, meanwhile, expresses a newfound determination to share her music with the world. You send the happy pair off with a smile, though you cannot help but notice the hint of melancholy in Prishe's eyes.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SEQ_00: Bakool Ja Ja has his eyes set on the dome.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SEQ_01: With no other pressing matters at hand, Bakool Ja Ja suggests the group press on to the dome where you are to meet with Oblivion. Alxaal, too, appears ready to depart. Prishe, meanwhile, is peering off into the distance, lost in thought. Bakool Ja Ja gently draws her attention back from the horizon, and the four of you are soon on your way.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SEQ_02: The impending meeting with Oblivion prompts Prishe to give voice to the idle musings that previously held her attention. The idea of merely being an echo weighs heavy on her mind, but Alxaal reminds her that─even if she is not the real Prishe─the future is what they make of it, and there is nothing to stop her from finding her own place in the world. She finds comfort in his words, but it quickly gives way to panic when a terrible pain suddenly shoots through her. For a brief moment, her body is enveloped in electric current, and an electrope cube can be seen thrumming in her chest. Fearing time may be running out, Alxaal urges the group to hurry to the dome.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SEQ_03: You meet with Kikwezana, an electrope engineer and member of Oblivion. He is admittedly unsure what he can do to help Alxaal and Prishe, but he is nevertheless determined to do all he can to be of assistance. First, he will need to collect samples to study. This leaves you and Bakool Ja Ja idle, and so he suggests the two of you return to Brightploom Post.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SEQ_04: A member of the Landsguard thanks you for your efforts in defeating Sareel Ja's echoes, and assures you the guard will keep watch for any new activity in Yak T'el. With naught left to be done save prepare for the next battle, Bakool Ja Ja bids you safe travels.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_SEQ_00: Yaana regards you with a wry smile.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_SEQ_01: As you stroll the streets of Solution Nine during your hiatus from the Arcadion, you find yourself before the familiar doors of Tritails Training. There you speak with Yaana, who informs you that heavyweight matches are soon to begin. Prior to that, however, she has a matter she wishes to discuss with you, and bids you follow her inside.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_SEQ_02: Yaana explains that to gather information on the president, she invited fellow former fighters to convene at the gym. Unfortunately, no one is able to share new information─that is, until Dancing Green speaks. He reveals that the president originally hailed from the nation of Lindblum, where the regeneration factor stimulant was developed. With increased confidence that there is truth behind the president's promise of the cure, the group decides to enact an operation on two fronts: firstly, for you to continue your climb to become grand champion. And secondly, to rescue Neyuni and Eutrope in secret. In so doing, you will have fulfilled your bargain with the megalomaniac, and removed his leverage against you.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_SEQ_03:
With some time remaining before matches begin, Yaana suggests you watch the Arcadion Hour broadcast for any potentially useful information. To your dismay, however, the program seems specifically designed to undermine your reputation and lower your spirits─the voice spearheading this derision towards you being none other than the heavyweight fighter Vamp Fatale. Still reeling from the viewing, you are surprised when the doors of Tritails Training suddenly open to reveal a motley group of young Alexandrians. Concerned by the broadcast's disparaging footage, they eagerly offer you words of encouragement, urging you to do your best in the heavyweight division. Soon after their departure, Yaana receives a call from Metem that matches are ready to begin. Now reinvigorated by the kind words of your fans, you set off for the Arcadion's greenroom with head held high.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion attendant in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_SEQ_04: Metem is understanding of Yaana's indignation, but carefully explains that all blame for the broadcast lies at the president's feet. According to him, the Arcadion's head is beginning to feel the walls close in around him, and so he is now attempting to oust you from the competition by any means necessary. With that being the case, Metem encourages you to channel any anger you may feel into the ring, and use it to overcome the challenges ahead. Judging by Yaana's fiery expression, she seems nigh ready to jump into the ring herself.
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_SEQ_00: By the look in her eyes, Yaana still smolders with rage.
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_SEQ_01:
Your first opponent of the heavyweight division is Vamp Fatale. Using the soul of a desmodont, she sucks the life from her foes and is notorious for taking pleasure in others' pain. On your path to become grand champion, she is yet another domino that must fall. Steeling your resolve, you set off to face the deadly dominatrix.

※AAC Heavyweight M1 can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_SEQ_02:
Despite her attempts to crush you under heel─or otherwise cut you into pieces with her horrific collection of saws and sharp objects─you manage to defeat the sadistic heel. Yaana will be eager to welcome the  of the hour back from the ring.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion attendant in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_SEQ_03: Beaming with pride upon your return, Yaana mentions that the audience went wild during your bout against the seductress. And having sufficiently savored your triumph, she appears to already be thinking ahead to your next match...
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_SEQ_00: Yaana appears to have something on her mind.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_SEQ_01: Informing you that arrangements for your second match are not yet complete, Yaana suggests that you both return to her gym for the meantime. With some luck, Retsarra may already be waiting with an update regarding the rescue mission.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_SEQ_02: Upon your arrival, you find the boy determined to join the gym from earlier, warning you tearfully that the place has been completely wrecked. Hurrying inside, you quickly find the culprits─a tag team duo known as the Xtremes. Metem soon enters with cameras, and announces that they shall be your next opponents. It is only after all parties have left that Retsarra at last appears. He informs you that he has made progress with the rescue mission, and has discovered a clue regarding Neyuni and Eutrope's whereabouts. During your next match, he and the others intend to make a rescue attempt. With a mind to put on a good show and keep the spotlight on you as your comrades work in the shadows, you make your way back to the greenroom.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_SEQ_03:
Yaana introduces the Xtremes, professional athletes who ride the waves of Solution Nine's artificial wave pool. The dynamic duo utilize the souls of storm divers, granting them the ability to manipulate water and fire respectively. To claim victory, you will need to adapt to the sudden and violent change of the elements─and the devastating coordinated maneuvers of a gnarly tag team.

※AAC Heavyweight M2 can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_SEQ_04:
You master the waves of flame and water both, sending the surfing duo sinking. Despite coming at you together, the Xtremes were out of their depth against you. Yaana will no doubt wish to celebrate this victory with you─and for more reasons than one.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion attendant in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_SEQ_05: Yaana welcomes you back with a look of smug self-satisfaction, savoring the humbling you dished out to the Xtremes. With one more victory under your belt, only the grand champion remains.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_SEQ_00: Satisfaction is writ plain on Yaana's face.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_SEQ_01: With preparations for the heavyweight title match underway, Yaana proposes returning to her gym, where you can rest up before the big event. Yet no sooner do you exit the Arcadion than you are accosted by the heavyweights Vamp Fatale, Deep Blue, and Red Hot. Their ambush is cut short, however, by the sudden arrival of the Tyrant. Making short work of them, he then demands you learn of the Arcadion's history, if you are so determined to alter its future. It is clear through his explanation that he believes the usage of feral souls is crucial to the institution's identity. While there are fans who agree, there are also those who would welcome change. The Tyrant departs as suddenly as he appeared, and with your path clear at last, Yaana would hurry back to learn how the rescue mission fared.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_SEQ_02: Entering the gym, you see that the others are yet to return, leaving Yaana visibly anxious. Just as you are trying to take her mind off of the mission, Retsarra at last appears─and behind him, a slightly disheveled, but otherwise hale Neyuni. Once all are present, she explains that the kidnappers removed Eutrope's regulator, and took her somewhere else. The very same modus operandi the president used to cover up the true fate of the immortalized. Yaana loses hope for a moment, until Dancing Green offers some much needed words of encouragement. Leaving Eutrope's rescue in Metem's hands, it is your mission to secure the cure by usurping the Tyrant's throne. With Neyuni's discovery that he intends to use the soul of a behemoth in battle, you can face him with full knowledge of what he may bring to bear. And it seems even Pomb, Hector's adorable kitten, wishes to cheer you on─how could you possibly lose?
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_SEQ_03:
Given the publicity for the title match, Yaana expects there to be fans along the way to the Arcadion, and proposes you speak with them before the grand event. Perhaps their words may even serve to buoy your spirits...

※You must be accompanied by Yaana and Pomb to complete this task. Speak with either of them again in front of Tritails Training should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_SEQ_04:
Speaking with fans along True Vue, you are reminded of how your actions can inspire others─and you in turn feel a surge of inspiration and encouragement from their words. The time of the title match draws near, and so you venture forth to the Arcadion alongside your second and the most adorable of cheerers.

※You must be accompanied by Yaana and Pomb to complete this task. Speak with either of them again in front of Tritails Training should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_SEQ_05: The Arcadion attendant cordially welcomes you as always, albeit sparing some slight interest regarding Pomb's presence. Yaana informs the man that Pomb is there to cheer you on, sating his curiosity and prompting him to guide you to the greenroom.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_SEQ_00: Yaana is ready to introduce the grand champion.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_SEQ_01:
You have climbed the ranks and through the tiers, at long last reaching the grand champion─the Tyrant. Long has he stood as an indomitable wall, repelling any would-be usurper to his throne. With martial mastery and the brutality of a behemoth his to wield, he will be a more daunting foe than any before. To seize his crown, you shall need to bring your all to bear.

※AAC Heavyweight M3 can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_SEQ_02:
True to his name, the Tyrant fights you without reserve, wielding every weapon he has at his disposal to defeat you. Yet his iron fist cracks against your unshakable resolve, bringing an end to his long reign. As you prepare to return to the greenroom, you are filled with both a sense of fulfillment for your achievement─and a nagging apprehension of what may lie in store.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion attendant in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_SEQ_03: The heretofore innocuous referee is revealed to be the secret apparatus of the president, who beckons you to join him at the highest level of the Arcadion, where he holds the Drop of Life. Accompanied by Yaana and Metem, you follow the device to the megalomaniac's lair, where you discover his true form─a monstrosity known as the Lindwurm, the apparent namesake of Lindblum. Adorning his quarters─a recreation of Lindblum's grand theaters─is none other than the corpses of the immortalized. To Yaana's horror, you see Eutrope's body among them. The president explains that he has attempted to nurture a fighter who could contend against him over the years, never finding success until you appeared. Now, if you are to become the true grand champion, he demands you face him in battle, and give the people of Alexandria the greatest show they have ever seen.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_SEQ_04: Your return to the greenroom is silent, save for the sound of Yaana's muted sobbing. When you finally speak to her, you can see that she is clearly still in shock, unable to hide the trembling in her voice. Perhaps it would be best to give her a moment to grieve and come to terms with her loss.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_SEQ_00: Yaana is beside herself with grief.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_SEQ_01:
Still reeling from the revelation that Eutrope and the other fighters have already perished, Yaana implores you to avenge them, and bring the president to justice. To leave that man─that monstrosity─unpunished for his crimes would be a crime in itself. And so you ready yourself to face the serpentine Lindwurm.

※AAC Heavyweight M4 can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_SEQ_02: With its astounding ability to twist, contort, and regenerate its body, the Lindwurm is a fearsome foe indeed. Yet through all the venom and gore, you triumph, bringing the great serpent low. The matter of the cure still remains, however...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_SEQ_03: Just as Yaana demands the location of the Drop of Life, Metem steps forward to explain that it must be extracted from the Lindwurm's heart. With sorrow in his voice, he continues his explanation, but is cut short when the felled beast suddenly regenerates once more. Seeing this, Yaana abandons her regulator, inspired to fight the monster unenhanced after your example. Your retired comrades soon join to even the odds, and just when it seems their combined strength is not enough, who should appear but the presumed dead Brute Bomber. Beckoning them to channel their aether to him, the reviled heel then sends you a fiery infusion of energy. With everyone's strength behind you, you dropkick the Lindwurm and bring it down yet again. It is at this moment that the Tyrant and other heavyweights appear, and summarily end the tormented president's life. The Lindwurm's heart at last extracted, Metem vows to see every soul cured of the disease─Eutrope and the immortalized not least of all.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_SEQ_04:
You speak with Neyuni at Tritails Training, hopeful that your afflicted comrades will make a full recovery from psychonekrosis. After a not-insignificant wait, you are relieved to see them return alongside Metem, who informs you the Drop of Life was effective. Furthermore, he states that the souls in the Arcadion's repository have been freed, and henceforth, matches will pit only unenhanced fighters against each other. This unfortunately means you can no longer participate, as no fighter can contend against you. On the bright side, you still have your crowning ceremony to look forward to. Metem bids you come to the Arcadion when you are ready for the big event.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the Arcadion attendant in front of the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_SEQ_05: Your crowning ceremony is once again interrupted by the belligerent Brute Bomber. This time, however, it is the agile Black Cat who leaps into the ring, and makes ready to brawl against him in your place. An apt way for the new era of the Arcadion to begin, if the audience's excitement is any indication.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_SEQ_06: Apologizing for the sudden altercation during your ceremony, Yaana is hopeful that people will continue to enjoy the Arcadion's shows, and will do her best to raise the excitement to higher highs. Reflecting on all that has come to pass, she admits that she played into the president's hands from the start─yet for all his scheming, without you at the center of it all, she is sure this favorable outcome would not have been possible. With that, she hopes that you, the newly designated “eternal grand champion,” will drop by to see her and everyone else when time allows. And as she departs, you feel deep down in your heart that the president's final words ring true─the Arcadion's future is bright indeed...
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_SEQ_00: The Landsguard looks relieved to see you.
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_SEQ_01: The Landsguard is pleased to report the woods remain quiet, and his men remain on high alert in the event new echoes appear. He goes on to tell you that Kikwezana has finished his tests and is ready to share his findings. Assuming you wish to be privy to the results, the Landsguard urges you to go and meet with Prishe and the others at the outskirts.
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_SEQ_02: An examination of Prishe and Alxaal has shown that, while Alxaal's core shows no signs of serious damage, Prishe is at risk of disappearing should she find herself in harm's way again. Unfortunate news made all the more terrible when Kikwezana receives word of a possible echo sighting in Mamook. You waste no time in heading back.
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_SEQ_03: You arrive in Mamook to find a number of slain enemies that are indeed echoes. Among their remains you find an invitation from none other than Sareel Ja. He invites you once more to Jeuno, claiming a vessel for his king has at last been decided. Because there are also echoes yet running rampant to the south, however, Bakool Ja Ja elects to remain with the Landsguard. This leaves you, Alxaal, and Prishe to go and confront Sareel Ja in Jeuno.
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_SEQ_04:
Sareel Ja has set the stage for what appears to be your final encounter, and while Prishe is all too eager to give him a sound thrashing, Alxaal insists she stay put, lest her electrope core be fractured any further. She reluctantly agrees, leaving you and Alxaal to brave a gauntlet of echoes.

※Windurst: The Third Walk can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_SEQ_05: You and Alxaal remain undaunted as you brave a number of strange landscapes, each home to powerful echoes. The journey culminates in a battle against the god Shinryu, said to have brought ruin to the twin of Vana'diel. With help from Alxaal, and the unexpected arrival of Prishe, you prove triumphant.
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_SEQ_06: With the “perfect vessel” defeated, and the shade of Gulool Ja Ja himself gone as well, Sareel Ja elects to retreat. Before you can apprehend him, he disappears through a portal, abandoning Jeuno for the woods of Yak T'el.
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_SEQ_07: Rather than potentially run headlong into danger, Alxaal suggests regrouping with Bakool Ja Ja. Perhaps he and the Landsguard will be able to help track Sareel Ja down.
TEXT_KINGEA302_05480_SEQ_00: Alxaal is eager to pursue Sareel Ja.
TEXT_KINGEA302_05480_SEQ_01: Hoping the Landsguard has spied signs of Sareel Ja, Alxaal suggests returning to Mamook, hopeful to soon pick up the trail.
TEXT_KINGEA302_05480_SEQ_02: The Landsguard have succeeded in routing the echoes that were wandering about the woods, but they recently lost contact with one of their scouts near Gok Draak Descent. Their last communication was a sighting of Sareel Ja. Keen to follow this lead, Alxaal wastes no time darting off to the west, leaving you to follow after him.
TEXT_KINGEA302_05480_SEQ_03: You corner Sareel Ja at the heart of the Skydeep Cenote, and after a brief altercation, you subdue him just in time for the Landsguard to arrive. Prishe and Alxaal are left to wonder what they will do with no means home when a most unexpected individual appears─Shantotto. Rather than explain the reason for her arrival, she first suggests moving to a location less painful on the eyes. To that end, you all decide to return to Mamook.
TEXT_KINGEA302_05480_SEQ_04: As Shantotto explains it, a disturbance in the interplanar space between worlds drew her attention to Sareel Ja's scheming, which resulted in her dispatching one of her magicked dolls to investigate the matter. Now that he has been apprehended, however, she is ready to return the doll home, but not before offering Prishe and Alxaal safe passage back to Vana'diel. With a little persuasion on your part, they take her up on the offer. However, they would like to take one last look about Tuliyollal before they leave.
TEXT_KINGEA302_05480_SEQ_05: While you accompany Prishe and Alxaal, Bakool Ja Ja offers to show Shantotto about Tuliyollal. To start, Prishe suggests making for Brightploom Post, taking in the sights along the way.
TEXT_KINGEA302_05480_SEQ_06: You arrive at Brightploom Post after a leisurely stroll through the city, affording Prishe and Alxaal to say their good-byes to a member of the Landsguard. With no other key points of interest begging for your attention, the three of you then proceed to Xbalyav Ty'e.
TEXT_KINGEA302_05480_SEQ_07: Bakool Ja Ja arrives shortly after you, and much to Prishe's delight, he offers to treat the three of you to tacos. The occasion is made more auspicious by a special performance by none other than Scoria, who continues on her path to become a renowned singer. They take this opportunity to say their good-byes, and wish each other well in their endeavors.
TEXT_KINGEA302_05480_SEQ_08: With all their business settled, Prishe and Alxaal are ready to return home. Shantotto recommends leaving from Jeuno, as the link between this world and Vana'diel is strongest there.
TEXT_KINGEA302_05480_SEQ_09: Prishe and Alxaal focus their thoughts on home, and after a brief incantation, Shantotto conjures a rift to take them back to Vana'diel. After exchanging heartfelt good-byes, the three take their leave, the silence of their absence now echoing through the city.
TEXT_KINGEA302_05480_SEQ_10: With Prishe, Alxaal, and Shantotto returned to Vana'diel, there is naught left to do but return to Mamook, relay the news to Miilal Ja, and reflect on your journey.
TEXT_KINGEA302_05480_SEQ_11: Your journey has left you to consider the path you walk, and the one you might have walked under different circumstances. Though the possibilities are seemingly without limit, you believe it all but certain that someday you, Prishe, and Alxaal will cross paths once more.
